products.name: Desmos
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI features: none recorded. Use: Graphing calculators and classroom activities. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: Anyone can use calculators without an account; classroom accounts free. Privacy: No signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement listed in one K-12 directory. profile_text.body:
Desmos Studio builds free math tools, including Graphing, Scientific, Geometry, and 3D Calculators along with Notebook, according to its website. The site describes the math as "beautiful" and free, and invites visitors to explore the tools, partner with the company, or browse examples for inspiration.

The company's tracked product is Desmos, listed under Education and Research AI. The calculators and classroom activities are used by teachers and students, and anyone can use the calculators without an account, with classroom accounts free. No AI features are recorded for the product. Pricing is mixed: the calculators are free, Amplify Classroom (formerly Desmos Classroom) is free, and the Amplify Desmos Math curriculum is paid. One K-12 directory does not list a signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement for the product.
